Pulmonary vascular complications in children who survive long-term after Kasai portoenterostomy for biliary atresia: a narrative review

Mechanisms of HPS and PoPH. HPS is associated with vasodilation through the effects of the ET-NO-cGMP pathway and the VEGF-Akt-NO/PKC-PGI2 pathway, and intestinal bacterial translocation also participates in this process by macrophages. PoPH is mainly linked to vasoconstriction caused by vasoconstrictors such as endothelin.
